For our client in the Kortrijk region, we are looking for a motivated Carpet Finishing Operator to strengthen our team on the finishing line.

 

• Cutting and finishing carpets to size

• Processing carpets on the finishing line

• Carrying out quality checks

• Attaching fringes when necessary

• Applying labels to carpets

• Ensuring a neat and high-quality finish

Job Requirements:

• You are precise and enjoy working with your hands

• You have an eye for quality and attention to detail

• You can work independently, but you are also a team player

• Experience in carpets, textiles or garment manufacturing is a plus

• Experience is not required: motivation and a positive work attitude are important

• You speak Dutch, French or English

Are you ready to lead global network & security projects, from SD-WAN and Cisco infrastructure to firewall, WLAN and data centre implementations?

Are you an experienced Network & Security Specialist looking for a role that combines hands-on technical expertise, project ownership and international collaboration?

We are looking for a Group ICT Network & Security Project Specialist to join an international ICT infrastructure team in Groot-Bijgaarden.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for the end-to-end management and implementation of network and security projects, while also providing advanced support for a global IT environment serving approximately 9,000 users across 100+ sites worldwide.

You’ll work closely with network and security architects, regional and local IT teams, infrastructure specialists and external technology partners to ensure secure, reliable and high-performing connectivity.
Role
• Lead Network & Security Projects: Manage projects from the initial planning and budget phase through design, implementation, documentation and follow-up.
• Firewalling & Load Balancing: Troubleshoot, maintain and implement firewall and load-balancing solutions and features.
• LAN & WLAN: Install, configure and troubleshoot Cisco switching and wireless infrastructure across datacentres, offices, factories and remote sites.
• SD-WAN: Collaborate with global WAN providers to ensure reliable and performant connectivity across more than 100 locations.
• L2/L3 Support: Provide advanced operational support for complex networking and security issues, working directly or alongside local IT teams.
• Monitoring: Maintain and monitor network and security monitoring systems, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.
• Technical Documentation: Interpret and maintain existing documentation and create technical/design documentation for new installations and projects.
• Infrastructure Installation: Support physical installations, including racking and stacking, initial equipment configuration, cabling and troubleshooting.
• Cross-functional Collaboration: Coordinate with infrastructure, security, HQ IT and local IT teams to ensure successful project delivery.
• Prioritisation: Balance project responsibilities with operational support and maintenance, ensuring business-critical activities receive the appropriate priority.
You’ll also participate in a 24/7 standby rotation for critical incidents, approximately once every 8 weeks.

Profile
We’re looking for a technically strong and hands-on professional who enjoys solving complex problems and taking ownership of projects.
Required
• 5+ years of relevant experience in LAN/WAN, networking and/or security.
• Strong knowledge of:
• SD-WAN
• Firewall and Cloud Proxy technologies
• Cisco wired and wireless networking
• TCP/IP and OSI layers 1–7
• Switching and routing
• Wireless networking
• Firewall troubleshooting
• Experience managing network/security projects from planning through implementation.
• Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills.
• Hands-on mentality with a proactive approach.
• Ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills.
• Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
• Stress-resistant and comfortable working in a global environment.Nice to have
Experience with:

• Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) or equivalent
• Cisco Nexus
• F5 Load Balancers
• Palo Alto Firewalls
• Sophos Firewalls
• Azure Network Fundamentals
• Wireless standards
• Monitoring technologies such as NetFlow, SNMP, Syslog and real-time alerts
• Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, Palo Alto, F5, or equivalentLanguages & travel
• English: strong professional proficiency
• Dutch and French: required
• Comfortable working with international colleagues and stakeholders.
• Willing to travel internationally for short assignments of 5–10 days, approximately 1–2 times per year.

Responsibilities

• Inventory, map, and classify critical data assets along with their associated flows and dependencies.
• Define and implement data management policies, standards, and procedures across the organization.
• Establish data protection requirements and access rules based on classification and the principle of least privilege.
• Facilitate training and awareness sessions to drive the adoption of data governance principles and best practices.
• Ensure data quality, discoverability, and documentation through master data management and lineage modeling.

Requirements

• 7+ years of experience in Data Governance and Data Quality management.
• Strong understanding of DAMA-DMBOK or similar data governance frameworks.
• Practical experience with governance and metadata management tools such as Collibra, Informatica, or OvalEdge.
• Proven track record in Change Management and technical documentation within complex environments.
• Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills to align business and IT objectives.
• You are fluent in French or Dutch with professional proficiency in English.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of NIS2 regulations and standards such as ISO/IEC 38505, ISO 8000, or GDPR.
• Knowledge of data modeling using UML or Archimate.
• Professional experience within regulated sectors like finance or the public sector.

What makes this role interesting?

You’ll be involved from A to Z:

•  Prepare and test solutions in the lab
•  Implement new installations at customer sites
•  Configure and manage complex UC/IT environments
•  Troubleshoot technical challenges
•  Perform upgrades, maintenance and lifecycle management
•  Support customers remotely and on-site
•  Give technical demos and customer training
•  Work with experienced colleagues on high-end technology projects
And because technology never stands still, you’ll continuously get the opportunity to learn new technologies and expand your expertise.

 

 Your technical playground

You’ll feel at home if you have experience with several of these:

• Enterprise Voice / Unified Communications
• Cisco networking / CCNA
• Windows Server
• Linux
• VMware and/or Nutanix
• Voice & Video technologies
• IT infrastructure & system engineering
You don’t have to know everything. Curiosity and the drive to learn matter just as much as your current skillset.

 

You are analytical, structured and solution-oriented.

You take ownership, enjoy working independently but also know the value of a strong team.

You’re service-minded, flexible and customer-focused, and you’re comfortable communicating with both technical colleagues and customers.

You have:

• A Master’s degree in Industrial Sciences – Electronics/ICT or ICT, or
• A Bachelor’s degree in Electronics/ICT + 3–5 years of relevant experience
• Good knowledge of networking and Windows Server environments
• Experience with Enterprise Voice / UC is a strong plus
• Fluency in Dutch and French, and good knowledge of English
• A driving licence B

Do you have experience in production or a technical background, and are you willing to work in shifts? Do you speak Dutch or English fluently?

• As a Production Worker, you will be responsible for making safety boots.

• Assembling components (steel toe cap, lining and steel sole) onto the mould

• Cleaning the machine

• After completing internal training, you will also be able to operate two other machines

• Experience as a production worker is required

• You are eager to learn and have a strong focus on quality

• You have your own means of transport

• You have a good command of Dutch or English

In this dynamic role, you will be a key player in our marketing efforts, focusing on both content creation and campaign execution for the Benelux market.

Content & Localization

• 
Translate & Localize: You will deliver high-quality translations from English to Dutch and French for a wide range of marketing materials, including websites, social media, newsletters, and videos, skillfully adapting the content to resonate with the Benelux market.

• 
Ensure Brand Consistency: Act as a brand guardian by meticulously reviewing and proofreading all texts to ensure they are consistent, accurate, and perfectly aligned with our brand voice.

• 
Create Engaging Content: Support the creation of compelling marketing content that highlights the innovation and value of Bosch parts, equipment, and services.

Marketing & Campaign Support

• 
Campaign Execution: Drive the coordination and execution of promotional campaigns, from creating newsletters to preparing materials and managing all follow-up activities.

• 
Digital Channel Management: Keep our digital presence fresh and relevant by updating customer portals, managing website content, and adapting our social media presence for local audiences.

• 
Event & Logistical Support: Contribute to the successful organization of customer events and marketing initiatives, including handling the internal ordering and logistics of point-of-sale materials.

• 
Analysis & Reporting: Help shape our strategy by preparing insightful presentations, conducting market and competitor analysis, and contributing to monthly data updates for new product introductions.

• 
You are currently a student pursuing a degree in Marketing, Communication, Business, Translation, or Language Studies, with a clear passion for content creation and marketing communications.

• 
You are highly proficient with the MS Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams). Experience with creative tools like Adobe InDesign or Premiere Pro is a significant advantage.

• 
As a well-organized and detail-oriented multitasker, you thrive in a fast-paced environment and can work independently to meet tight deadlines.

• 
You are an excellent communicator and a collaborative team player who enjoys achieving goals together.

• 
Language Skills:

• 
Dutch: Native or equivalent proficiency (Mandatory)

• 
English: Full professional fluency (Mandatory)

• 
French: A good working knowledge is a strong asset.

Key Responsibilities

Project Procurement & Strategic Sourcing

• Develop and implement procurement strategies in collaboration with Project, Engineering and Commercial teams.
• Identify business requirements, potential suppliers and sourcing opportunities.
• Develop sourcing strategies and lead RFx / tendering processes.
• Prepare supplier consultations, analyze bids and develop sourcing recommendations.
• Lead negotiations on pricing, lead times, commercial and contractual terms and conditions.
• Identify cost reduction and value improvement opportunities throughout the procurement lifecycle.
• Develop Best-Cost Country Sourcing strategies, with a particular focus on Central and Eastern Europe.
Supplier Management

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with key strategic suppliers.
• Assess suppliers' capabilities, manufacturing capacity, geographical footprint and financial stability.
• Evaluate their ability to meet technical, quality and project schedule requirements.
• Contribute to supplier rationalization and supplier base development.
• Identify and resolve issues related to cost, quality, capacity, delivery and supplier performance.
• Work closely with Supplier Quality / Supplier Performance teams.
Contract & Change Management

• Lead the preparation and negotiation of supplier contracts.
• Manage supplier commitments following contract or purchase order award.
• Manage contractual changes, scope changes and claims.
• Assess the financial and contractual impact of changes and lead the associated negotiations.
• Ensure compliance with procurement procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.
• Work with Finance / Accounts Payable teams to resolve discrepancies between invoices and purchase orders.
Project Management

• Manage several procurement projects simultaneously in an international environment.
• Define action plans and monitor milestones, risks and expected benefits.
• Identify potential roadblocks and coordinate their resolution.
• Provide regular reporting to key stakeholders.
• Coordinate project changes and ensure alignment between the various functions and teams involved.
 

 

About You

You have significant experience in industrial procurement / project procurement, ideally gained within a technical and international environment.

We are looking for:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Procurement, Supply Chain, Business or a related field.
• 8+ years of experience in Procurement / Strategic Sourcing, ideally within an industrial environment.
• Significant experience managing complex projects.
• Strong knowledge of RFx, sourcing and supplier negotiations.
• Proven experience in Supplier Relationship Management (SRM).
• Solid experience in contract negotiation and Contract / Change Management.
• Experience in international sourcing, ideally with a good understanding of the EMEA supplier market.
• Experience sourcing from Central and Eastern Europe would be a strong advantage.
• Experience in Energy, Engineering, Heavy Industry, Automotive, Aerospace, Oil & Gas or other technically complex industries will be considered.
• Experience with SAP / SAP Ariba is an advantage.
• Good knowledge of Project Management tools and methodologies.
• Fluent English is essential due to the international environment.
• Willingness to travel internationally, up to approximately 30%.
 

Previous experience in the nuclear sector is not necessarily required. We are particularly interested in candidates coming from complex, highly technical and international industrial environments.

As a Technical Support Advisor, you are the point of contact for BEA's business customers throughout Europe, with a particular history in the German-speaking area. 

Your missions:
 
Customer & internal technical support
  
• Answer customers' technical questions by phone, WhatsApp or e-mail, with a particular focus on VIP customers and high-value sensors. 
• Diagnose faults remotely and propose concrete solutions 
• Support our customers' technicians in the installation, wiring and configuration of BEA sensors. 
• Manage incoming calls from the technical hotline for Europe and provide product support to the European sales team. 
• Provide ongoing internal support in conjunction with other members of the technical team. 
• Participate in the creation, optimization and coordination of technical documentation (e.g. wiring diagrams, instructions) for customers in the field.  
Continuous improvement & documentation
  
• Collect and transmit relevant field feedback to the sales, product and R&D teams, in a logic of continuous improvement. 
• Write reports and feed the internal knowledge base, to promote the sharing of expertise within the company (sales, marketing, product). 
• Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to the quality of service and products, using a ticketing system, to measure customer satisfaction and identify areas for improvement. 
• Participate in product tests (BEA sensors and competitors) in collaboration with Product Management and R&D teams. 
• Organize the planning of customer visits by the technical team.  
Team
 
You will join the sales department, within the Pedestrian Door Detectors (PES) segment.
 
Your direct technical referent, Sandra, currently holds this position, which she knows like the back of her hand. She will still be active in customer technical support, with a stronger focus on internal training, while actively supporting you during your integration. Trilingual, rigorous, challenging and always available, she ensures that customers receive impeccable service.

Your experience and education: 
 
• Minimum 2 years of experience in a support function 
• Strong interest in electronic, electromechanical or connected solutions 
• Good command of office tools and ability to read technical guides 
• Excellent command of German, French and English (spoken and written)  
Your soft skills and personal qualities:
  
• Excellent interpersonal skills, ability to ask the right questions and reassure customers 
• Curiosity, thirst for learning and spirit of investigation 
• Method, rigor and stress management 
• Taste for teamwork and openness to feedback 
• Ability to interact with different internal contact (PM, sales, R&D, quality)

As a weaver, you’ll be hands-on with Dornier dobby and jacquard weaving machines. You’ll keep the looms supplied with bobbins and yarns, ensure everything runs efficiently, and carry out small repairs when needed.
Your day involves moving between machines, fixing thread breaks, and keeping your work area in top condition. You collaborate with colleagues to deliver a high-quality, exclusive textile product.
Ready to put your weaving skills to work and be part of a motivated team? Apply today!

• Experience with weaving

• Attention to detail

• Problem-solving mindset

• Team player

• Stress-resistant

• Communicate in English, Dutch or French

The company is a leading international player operating in a highly customer-centric and relationship-driven industry.
In Belgium, it works closely with an extensive network of professional partners, providing innovative solutions, commercial support and expert guidance to help them grow their business.
Backed by a strong culture of innovation and continuous improvement, the company is recognized for its commitment to customer excellence, people development and sustainable growth.

Jobomschrijving

The Account Manager - Optical Sector will have the following responsibilities :

• Drive commercial growth across Flanders by expanding the presence of ophthalmic solutions within targeted healthcare accounts.
• Identify, engage and develop new business opportunities with ophthalmologists, clinics and hospital-based eye care professionals.
• Strengthen partnerships with existing customers while building long-term relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers.
• Lead the development of strategic growth areas such as myopia management, leveraging clinical evidence and market insights.
• Promote innovative vision care solutions, including products addressing presbyopia and eye protection needs.
• Design and implement territory plans that translate market opportunities into sustainable business results.
• Act as a trusted advisor to customers by providing expertise on products, market trends, pricing and practice development opportunities.
• Coordinate cross-functional activities, including product implementation, customer training and ongoing support, to ensure a best-in-class customer experience.

• Optometrist
• Proven success in sales (MedTech / Eyecare is a must)
• Hunter profile
• Network in ophthalmology 
• Fluent in Dutch and English (French is a plus)

Industry- automation systems warehouse

Jobomschrijving

For a company that designs, integrates, and maintains logistics automation solutions to optimize internal logistics processes in warehouses, production, and distribution

Your Responsibilities:
	
• Maintenance, repair, and installation of complex warehouse automation systems.	
• Ensure smooth operation of our installations by performing timely maintenance and resolving technical issues quickly and efficiently.	
• Analyze malfunctions and resolve them independently, with an eye for safety and customer satisfaction.	
• Work mostly independently, but be a team player when necessary.	
• Report your interventions in our system to ensure and improve quality.

	
• Diploma in electromechanics, electricity, and/or mechanics.	
• Basic knowledge of automation is a plus, such as knowledge of SCADA, use of multimeters.	
• Several years of experience in a technical role is a plus.	
• Work independently, accurately, and customer-oriented.	
• Fluent communication in Dutch and/or English.	
• No fear of heights; our work takes place at different levels.	
• Good physical condition for physical work.	
• Flexible and willing to work occasionally outside standard hours.	
• Motivated, responsible, and keep administration tidy.	
• Eager to learn and share a passion for technology.	
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, PLC control systems; if this appeals to you, this job is for you.	
• All-round PC skills and experience with CMMS systems, (Sprocket).	
• “You are open to working weekends.

Our client is a well-established and highly respected real estate agency with a strong presence in the market. Operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, the company is known for its commitment to excellence, client-centric approach, and entrepreneurial mindset. With an international outlook and a diverse portfolio of clients and projects, the agency offers a stimulating workplace where collaboration, professionalism, and innovation are valued. Joining this organization means becoming part of a successful team that thrives on challenge, growth, and delivering exceptional service.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide comprehensive administrative and organizational support to the management team.
• Manage calendars, coordinate meetings, and organize business travel arrangements.
• Prepare, review, and maintain correspondence, reports, presentations, and other business documents.
• Act as a key point of contact for clients, tenants, landlords, and external stakeholders, ensuring professional communication at all times.
• Support the coordination and follow-up of real estate transactions, property management activities, and client projects.
• Organize internal and external events, meetings, and client visits.
• Maintain and update databases, CRM systems, and property-related records, ensuring data accuracy and confidentiality.

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
• Excellent communication skills in English and French; additional languages are a strong asset.
• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and a high level of professionalism.
• Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with CRM or property management systems.

Looking for a new challenge in supply chain within an international and forward-thinking organization?

As a Supply Chain Assistant you will support the supply chain team with daily tasks such as:

• Manage material availability and inventory levels to ensure uninterrupted operations. 
• Maintain SAP MRP parameters and follow up on shortages, replenishmen, and planning activities. 
• Coordinate with Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering and Operations teams to resolve material-related issues. 
• Analyze KPIs and SAP reports to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
• Support process improvement and optimization initiatives for critical materials and supply chain workflows.

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Good knowledge of SAP, MRP planning and inventory management processes.
• Strong Excel and data analysis skills.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills with a proactive and results-oriented mindset.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing customer orders from A to Z, ensuring an excellent customer experience, and acting as the key point of contact between customers and internal departments. You will work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Production teams to guarantee smooth order processing and timely deliveries.

Client Details

Our client, an international company operating in the manufacturing sector, is looking for a Customer Service Representative to join its customer-facing team.

Description

In this role, you will be responsible for managing customer orders from A to Z, ensuring an excellent customer experience, and acting as the key point of contact between customers and internal departments. You will work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Production teams to guarantee smooth order processing and timely deliveries.

 

Key Responsibilities

• Manage customer orders throughout the entire order-to-cash process.
• Enter and follow up on orders in the ERP system.
• Serve as the primary contact for customer enquiries regarding orders, deliveries, and product availability.
• Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient order fulfillment.
• Monitor delivery schedules and proactively communicate any changes or delays.
• Resolve customer issues and identify appropriate solutions.
• Maintain accurate customer records and administrative documentation.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives related to customer service processes.
• Build and maintain strong long-term customer relationships.
 

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Previous experience in Customer Service, Order Management, Sales Support, or a similar administrative position.
• Strong communication skills and customer-oriented mindset.
• Fluent in Dutch and English. French is considered an asset.
• Experience working with ERP systems (SAP knowledge is a plus).
• Good command of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

Personal Skills

• Proactive and solution-oriented.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Team player with a collaborative mindset.
• Resilient and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Customer-focused with excellent relationship-building skills.

jobs.occupation: Bus Mechanic – good salary + training opportunies
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working on vehicles and solving technical problems? In this role as a bus mechanic, you ensure that coaches are safe, reliable and ready for daily operations.

• You carry out maintenance and repairs on buses.

• You diagnose mechanical issues and fix them efficiently.

• You perform preventive maintenance to keep vehicles in top condition.

• You work on a varied fleet of different brands and models.

• You ensure every vehicle meets safety and quality standards.

• You have a background in mechanics (experience is a strong plus).

• You can work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.

• You are able to identify and solve technical problems.

• You are eager to learn and interested in new vehicle technologies (like electricity).

• You are open to following additional training.

• You speak Dutch or English.

• You are flexible with working hours while valuing a good work-life balance.

• A driving license D is a plus.

The client is a well-established international premium fashion brand, renowned for its timeless style, exceptional craftsmanship, and strong commitment to quality. Combining heritage with innovation, the company offers sophisticated collections that inspire customers worldwide and delivers a premium retail experience across its stores and digital channels.

Jobomschrijving

As Retail Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the performance of multiple stores, ensuring operational excellence, and delivering outstanding commercial results. Acting as a true brand ambassador, you will play a key role in translating business strategy into action on the shop floor.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive sales growth and profitability across your store portfolio.
• Lead, coach, and develop Store Managers and their teams to achieve ambitious targets.
• Monitor KPIs and implement action plans to maximize performance.
• Ensure a premium customer experience aligned with brand standards.
• Optimize staffing, productivity, and operational efficiency.
• Partner closely with Head Office teams on merchandising, marketing, and retail initiatives.
• Identify opportunities to improve processes and support business growth.
• Foster a positive, engaging, and high-performance culture.

• Proven experience in a multi-site retail management role within fashion, lifestyle, or premium retail.
• Strong commercial mindset with a track record of delivering results.
• Inspirational leader with excellent coaching and people management skills.
• Data-driven and comfortable analyzing performance indicators.
• Passion for customer experience and brand excellence.
• Hands-on, proactive, and adaptable in a fast-paced retail environment.
• Fluent in French, Dutch and English.
